== Historical PC image ==
The card fields were compared with the original image [[:File:ANH-L-commencerecharging-holotable-2022-12-23.png]]. The original source bytes and immutable Git commit are credited on that File page. The historical image has no implemented GEMP text-state mapping yet. Its article therefore has no GEMP ID field. The current supported GEMP family remains <code>2_31</code>.
